newsDocuments.headline: Germany pursues new Russia sanctions despite US diesel deal

segments.text: BERLIN: Germany said Saturday it would continue to push for new EU sanctions against Russia despite Moscow’s agreement with Washington to release diesel to ease a fuel crunch.

US President Donald Trump said on social media Friday after talks with Russian leader Vladimir Putin: “Russia will immediately supply over 300,000 Tons of Diesel Fuel to the American and Global Marketplace.”
The Kremin said Russia “reaffirmed its readiness to supply oil and oil products to the American and world markets.”

newsDocuments.headline: Gold hits one-week high on softer oil prices

segments.text: NEW YORK: Gold rose to a one-week high on Friday, as falling oil prices eased concerns around inflation and pressure on US Treasuries, while traders assessed the likelihood of further US Federal Reserve interest rate hikes.
“Bullion is finding some breathing room today as oil benchmarks and longer-term Treasury yields ease away from recent highs,” said Han Tan, chief market analyst at Bybit.
